public.text: Direct ICD-11 input to decision support — Establishes a primary clinical use without claiming that ICD-11 itself is a complete decision-support knowledge base. This is a design recommendation consistent with the WHO clinical documentation hub (https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/clinician-documentation-hub).
public.suggestedRevision: Insert paragraph: Decision logic may reference ICD-11 concepts and expressions directly where they represent the information required by the rule. The rule package shall identify the terminology release, relevant clinical context, and tested interpretation of any postcoordination. It shall not require a SNOMED CT intermediate solely to consume ICD-11-coded data. Terminology services supply identified meaning and applicable relationships; the clinical recommendation, drug knowledge, inference logic, and validation of the decision remain separately governed responsibilities.
